int get_count(const QueueType *q){ if(q->rear>=q->front) return q->rear-q->front; return MAX_QUEUE_SIZE-q->front+q->rear; }
Equivalently, for ordinary small capacities: (q->rear-q->front+MAX_QUEUE_SIZE)%MAX_QUEUE_SIZE.
reasoning: Count the forward cyclic index distance from the slot before the first item (front) to the last item (rear). If rear>=front the distance is their difference; otherwise it wraps across M and equals M-front+rear. The reserved slot makes front==rear uniquely empty and maximum count M-1. The branch version avoids an unnecessarily large intermediate sum in the modulo expression. O(1) time and auxiliary space.
